proposals.evidence: Dhakal p. 59 prints /bʰeṭlə/ “met.” Turner9490 section 4 lists Nepali bheṭnu, Maithili bheṭab and Oriya bheṭibā “to meet,” whereas sections 1–3 concern other bhiṭ-/bhēṭ- developments. Darai -lə is the source-described past suffix, so this is an inflected reflex of the section-4 stem.
